packageRules.description: A Python minor (3.14 -> 3.15) is a runtime upgrade for every instance that runs Python as its app runtime: its own runtime Dockerfile must move in step, and its tools must support the new version. Keep it out of the automerged group, as its own PR for manual review.

Pin container images to their digest. Scoped to the docker managers on purpose: a global pinDigests also hits the pre-commit manager, whose tag revs can't be converted to digests (the update fails). GitHub Actions are pinned by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests instead.
Renovate can't regenerate .devcontainer/devcontainer-lock.json, so features are bumped by hand together with it (see .devcontainer/README.md).

customManagers.description: Container images that scripts/release-lib.sh pins by tag and digest (NODE_IMAGE, SYFT_IMAGE). The tag is currentValue and the sha256 is currentDigest, so Renovate bumps both. NODE_IMAGE moves with .devcontainer/Dockerfile's NODE_VERSION (same group); release-run.sh fails if they disagree.
